text:
jamie.ops: DRILL — kicking off a tabletop for incident communications. Scenario: Ingest API latency > 500ms for 60s across eu-west. This is a practice run only, please treat as DRILL in all comms. @oncall-bot, simulate a page to the on-call. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Paging samir.sre (priority: P1) — simulated from drill harness.

samir.sre: I’m on it (simulated). Quick assessment: traces show increased tail latency, ingress queue backpressure, not a total outage. Marking customer impact as degraded performance.

jamie.ops: Goal of drill: practice status page update + short customer notification + internal comms template + handoff. Timebox: 15m for drafting + 10m for feedback.

marco.eng: I can mock the metric graphs for the status page. Here’s a quick snippet to include in internal notes:

```
metric: ingest.request_latency.p99
before: 120ms
after: 650ms
spike_window: 00:02:00
```

anita.prod: Drafting status page copy now. First pass below — please flag wording as DRILL when we publish to staging status page.

anita.prod: [STATUS PAGE DRAFT]
We are currently investigating increased latency on the Ingest API in eu-west. Users may experience slower responses for ingestion requests. Our engineering team is investigating and working on mitigation. No data loss is expected. We will provide updates every 15 minutes. (This is a DRILL.)

lina.cs: For customer-facing channels, we should advise retries with backoff and point to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/retry-guidance

samir.sre: Internal comms template (short):

```
INCIDENT: Ingest API - eu-west (DRILL)
SEVERITY: Degraded Performance (simulated)
START: 2025-06-02T14:30:00Z (simulated)
IMPACT: Increased request latency; some customers may see higher ingestion times.
ACTIONS: Engineering investigating request queueing; temporary traffic rampdown to limit user impact.
NEXT STEPS: Run mitigations, gather logs, prepare postmortem drill.
POINTS OF CONTACT: samir.sre, anita.prod, jamie.ops.
```

tara.security: Flagging: if this were real and customer request includes PII, ensure DLP check for any diagnostic payloads before sharing externally. Noted for the drill only.

jamie.ops: Good note. Anita — can you craft a concise customer notification email we would send to affected customers (short/plaintext)?

anita.prod: Draft customer note (subject + body):

Subject: Service notification — temporary ingestion latency in eu-west (DRILL)

Body:
Hi there,

We’re running a drill simulating an increase in ingestion latency for services in the eu-west region. In a real incident we’d expect slower ingestion responses; no data is lost. If you are seeing higher latency, please retry with exponential backoff as described here: https://docs.redwood.ai/retry-guidance

We’ll follow up with a status update and a timeline for remediation. (DRILL — no action required.)

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support

lina.cs: That’s clear. Add a line about contacting support with request IDs if they need help.

anita.prod: Updated: added contact line.

samir.sre: Now practice posting to the staging status page. statusbot — post the draft with a DRILL banner.

statusbot: Posting to staging.status.redwood.ai — DRAFT POST (DRILL).

statusbot: [STAGING] Title: Ingest API — degraded performance in eu-west (DRILL)
Summary: We are investigating increased latency affecting ingestion requests in eu-west. This is a drill. We will update every 15 minutes.

marco.eng: Sending mocked graphs to the status page: p99 latency spike annotated. Link: https://staging.status.redwood.ai/incidents/ingest-latency-drill-1829003456

jamie.ops: Quick tabletop: who would we page to customers vs internal? Lina, you'd send customer note to impacted accounts; product ops would coordinate AEs for high-value customers. Anita, confirm channel.

lina.cs: Customer-facing sequence for real incident we practice: 1) Immediate status page (short), 2) High-touch customers get email + AE outreach, 3) Follow-up with timeline and RCA.

anita.prod: For canned triggers: if >5% of tenant requests > 500ms for 2m, we auto-open incident and post status. This drill validates that threshold and messaging.

samir.sre: Mitigation play in drill: reduce worker concurrency scaling to reduce queueing, enable partial traffic shed for non-critical tenants, and roll to a warmed model variant in another region if necessary. Practicing commands now:

```bash
# simulated command to scale down concurrency
redwood infra scale --pool ingest-eu --concurrency 120 --dry-run
```

marco.eng: Dry-run returned no errors. In real run ensure feature flags for regional fallback are set.

jamie.ops: Handoff time — samir, you’re taking the simulated lead for the next 10m; I’ll run comms cadence (every 15m) and own the status page updates. Anita, you prep the customer email with AC contact list. Lina, prep AE list.

samir.sre: Acknowledged. Starting simulated mitigation steps. Tracking in internal incident doc (DRILL).

statusbot: Update posted to staging.status.redwood.ai — Next update scheduled in 15 minutes (DRILL).

lina.cs: Quick feedback on templates: make the customer-facing copy simpler, avoid jargon like "ingress queue backpressure". Good to include estimated next update time.

anita.prod: Noted — simplified language in customer note.

jamie.ops: Meta feedback: add a short checklist to the internal template for comms handoff: 1) Post status, 2) Notify AE + CS, 3) Send support email, 4) Draft postmortem timeline.

samir.sre: Simulated mitigation appears to reduce tail latency in graphs. Will capture timestamps and mock logs for the postmortem drill.

marco.eng: I’ll attach a mock trace snippet to the doc for the RCA exercise.

tara.security: For postmortem drill, add security review step if we touched any data stores or credentials during mitigation.

jamie.ops: Great. Let’s wrap this drill. Quick retro in thread: what worked, what didn’t. I’ll start — worked: crisp status draft, quick handoff. Didn’t: need faster AE notification automation and clearer trigger thresholds for auto-post.

lina.cs: Worked: clean customer text. Didn’t: staging status page link was a little buried; add a direct AE-friendly link next time.

anita.prod: Worked: email template reusable. Didn’t: we spent time debating phrasing; pre-approved templates for DRILL vs Prod would save time.

samir.sre: Worked: mitigation play executed in simulated dry-run. Didn’t: runbook steps for partial traffic shed need clearer commands. Will update runbook.

jamie.ops: Action items (DRILL):
- samir.sre: update runbook with exact commands and verify dry-run flags (due 48h).
- anita.prod: create two pre-approved customer templates (DRILL/prod) and store in comms repo (due 48h).
- lina.cs: automate AE notification link in status page (due 72h).
- marco.eng: attach mock traces/graphs to the drill incident doc (due 24h).
- tara.security: add DLP/security checklist to postmortem template (due 72h).

jamie.ops: Thanks all — drill complete. Closing simulated incident and moving notes to /incidents/drills/1829003456. Please react with :white_check_mark: when noted.

marco.eng: :white_check_mark:

lina.cs: :white_check_mark:

anita.prod: :white_check_mark:

samir.sre: :white_check_mark: (closing simulated page)

statusbot: Simulated incident closed on staging.status.redwood.ai — DRILL complete.

oncall-bot: Simulated page resolved.

jamie.ops: Retro thread ends. We’ll run a follow-up async on action items. Thanks!
